extracted.intended_audience: researchers, students, policy analysts, and general readers seeking country reference statistics
extracted.subtask_description: Structured country profile / factbook entry listing geography, people, government, economy, communications, transportation, military, and transnational issues statistics and short narrative overviews.

rubrics_metrics.name: Introduction / Background
rubrics_metrics.description: Brief historical and contextual overview of the country's formation, major historical events, and general characterization (e.g., modern industrialized nation, colonial history, independence movements).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides a concise narrative summary of origins, major historical turning points, and distinguishing national characteristics; should orient the reader to socio-political context.

rubrics_metrics.name: Geographic location and coordinates
rubrics_metrics.description: Location description (region, bordering bodies/countries) and geographic coordinates (latitude/longitude).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include map references and clear regional placement (e.g., 'Western Europe, bordering the North Sea'); provide numeric coordinates where available.

rubrics_metrics.name: Area (total, land, water) and comparative area note
rubrics_metrics.description: Total area with breakdown for water and land, and a comparative note (e.g., 'slightly less than twice the size of New Jersey').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Report area in sq km and include a short comparative statement to aid comprehension.

rubrics_metrics.name: Land boundaries and border countries
rubrics_metrics.description: Total length of land boundaries and list of neighboring/border countries with distances where applicable.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: List border countries and approximate border lengths; if none, indicate 0 km.

rubrics_metrics.name: Coastline
rubrics_metrics.description: Length of coastline in km.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Report coastline length and note significant coastal features if relevant.

rubrics_metrics.name: Maritime claims
rubrics_metrics.description: Statements of territorial sea, exclusive economic zone, and other maritime claims (e.g., fishing zones).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specify nautical miles for territorial sea and EEZ; indicate exceptions if present.

rubrics_metrics.name: Climate
rubrics_metrics.description: Summary of dominant climate type(s) (e.g., temperate; marine; tropical) and seasonal notes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include modifiers (trade winds, seasonal characteristics) that affect local conditions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Terrain
rubrics_metrics.description: Brief description of major terrain types (e.g., coastal lowland, mountains, polders).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Note distinctive topographic features that shape land use or hazards.

rubrics_metrics.name: Elevation extremes
rubrics_metrics.description: Lowest and highest points with elevations (meters) and place names.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide named points and elevation values; include sea level references.

rubrics_metrics.name: Natural resources
rubrics_metrics.description: List of principal natural resources (e.g., natural gas, nickel, arable land).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Enumerate significant commodities that contribute to the economy or geopolitics.

rubrics_metrics.name: Land use and arable/permanent crop percentages
rubrics_metrics.description: Breakdown of land use categories (arable land, permanent crops, other) as percentages.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Present percentage figures and year of estimate where available.

rubrics_metrics.name: Irrigated land
rubrics_metrics.description: Area of irrigated land reported in sq km and year of estimate.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide numeric value and relevant year for context.

rubrics_metrics.name: Natural hazards
rubrics_metrics.description: List of significant natural hazards affecting the country (e.g., flooding, cyclones).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Indicate frequency or seasonality if provided (e.g., cyclones from November to March).

rubrics_metrics.name: Environment — current issues
rubrics_metrics.description: Concise statement of major environmental problems (e.g., water pollution, erosion from mining).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Mention specific pollutants or processes and geographic areas affected where noted.

rubrics_metrics.name: Environment — international agreements
rubrics_metrics.description: List of international environmental treaties and agreements to which the country is party.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Enumerate treaty names (e.g., Kyoto Protocol, Law of the Sea) and note party status.

rubrics_metrics.name: Population total and estimate year
rubrics_metrics.description: Total population with the date of the estimate (e.g., '16,318,199 (July 2004 est.)').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide the numeric estimate and the specific month/year note included on the page.

rubrics_metrics.name: Age structure
rubrics_metrics.description: Percent or counts of population by age groups (0-14, 15-64, 65+), often broken out by sex.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Report percentages and raw male/female counts where available and the estimate year.

rubrics_metrics.name: Median age
rubrics_metrics.description: Median age of the total population and by sex, with estimate year.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide numeric median years and whether figures are total/male/female.

rubrics_metrics.name: Population growth rate
rubrics_metrics.description: Annual population growth rate percentage with estimate year.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include the year of the estimate and whether net migration affects the rate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Birth rate and death rate
rubrics_metrics.description: Crude birth and death rates per 1,000 population with estimate year.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Give both rates and the year of the estimates.

rubrics_metrics.name: Net migration rate
rubrics_metrics.description: Net migration per 1,000 population with estimate year (positive or negative).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Report value and year; indicate sign (inflow or outflow).

rubrics_metrics.name: Sex ratio
rubrics_metrics.description: Sex ratio indicators at birth, for age groups, and total population (males per female).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide the various breakdowns included (at birth, under 15, 15-64, 65+, total).

rubrics_metrics.name: Infant mortality rate
rubrics_metrics.description: Infant deaths per 1,000 live births, often split by sex, with estimate year.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Report total and sex-disaggregated figures and the estimate year.

rubrics_metrics.name: Life expectancy at birth
rubrics_metrics.description: Life expectancy in years for total population and by sex, with estimate year.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include numeric values and the year of estimate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Total fertility rate
rubrics_metrics.description: Average children born per woman with estimate year.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide the numeric TFR and year of estimate.

rubrics_metrics.name: HIV/AIDS statistics
rubrics_metrics.description: Adult prevalence rate, number of people living with HIV/AIDS, and deaths where provided.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: List prevalence percentage and counts with year annotations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Nationality, ethnic groups, religions, languages, literacy
rubrics_metrics.description: Sociocultural descriptors including demonyms, major ethnic group percentages, religious composition, official and widely spoken languages, and literacy rate definition and estimates.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide proportions and any definitions used (e.g., literacy definition = age 15+ can read and write).

rubrics_metrics.name: Government — country name and government type
rubrics_metrics.description: Official and short forms of country name and the government form (e.g., constitutional monarchy, parliamentary).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include local-language names when provided and concise government classification.

rubrics_metrics.name: Administrative divisions and capital
rubrics_metrics.description: List of primary administrative divisions (e.g., provinces), their local terms, and the capital and seat of government if different.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Name number of divisions and list principal units when included.

rubrics_metrics.name: Dependents / dependent areas
rubrics_metrics.description: Notation of any dependent territories or constituent countries associated with the state (e.g., Aruba, Netherlands Antilles).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: State the dependency status and responsibilities (e.g., defense handled by another state).

rubrics_metrics.name: Independence, constitution, national holiday
rubrics_metrics.description: Key dates and legal foundations: independence date/events, constitution adoption/amendments, and national holidays.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include dates and brief explanatory notes on significance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Legal system and suffrage
rubrics_metrics.description: Description of the legal tradition (e.g., civil law) and voting age/eligibility rules.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Note special features (e.g., constitution does not permit judicial review) and voting age.

rubrics_metrics.name: Executive, legislative, and judicial branches
rubrics_metrics.description: Structure and composition of the executive (chief of state, head of government, cabinet), legislature (unicameral/bicameral, seats, election cycles), and judiciary (supreme court structure and appointment notes).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide numbers of seats, selection method, terms, recent election dates, and any notable appointment processes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Political parties and pressure groups
rubrics_metrics.description: List of major political parties and leaders, plus major pressure groups and labor federations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Name parties and leaders as listed; include trade union federations or major business groups when provided.

rubrics_metrics.name: International organization participation
rubrics_metrics.description: Listing of international organizations to which the country belongs (e.g., UN, WTO, IMF, EU).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Enumerate membership acronyms and note special statuses (observer, associate, guest).

rubrics_metrics.name: Diplomatic representation (in and from the US)
rubrics_metrics.description: Representative diplomatic contacts such as chief of mission, consulates, embassy addresses and phone/fax numbers when provided.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide names, addresses, and contact numbers as listed; separate inbound and outbound representation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Economy — overview narrative
rubrics_metrics.description: Short descriptive overview of the economy highlighting openness, main sectors, recent growth trends, and fiscal concerns.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Summarize strengths/weaknesses, sectoral emphasis, and recent macroeconomic trends.

rubrics_metrics.name: GDP — purchasing power parity (PPP)
rubrics_metrics.description: GDP expressed in PPP terms with the estimate year and value (e.g., '$461.4 billion (2003 est.)').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Report numeric PPP GDP and the year of estimation.

rubrics_metrics.name: GDP — real growth rate
rubrics_metrics.description: Annual real GDP growth percentage with estimate year.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include sign (negative or positive) and year of estimate.

rubrics_metrics.name: GDP — per capita (PPP)
rubrics_metrics.description: GDP per capita in PPP dollars with estimate year.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide numeric PPP per-capita figure and year.

rubrics_metrics.name: GDP composition by sector
rubrics_metrics.description: Percentage breakdown of GDP by sector (agriculture, industry, services) with estimate year.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Report sectoral percentages and year of estimate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Investment (gross fixed)
rubrics_metrics.description: Investment as percent of GDP (gross fixed capital formation) with estimate year.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide the percentage and year.

rubrics_metrics.name: Poverty and household income distribution
rubrics_metrics.description: Population below poverty line (if available) and household income/consumption shares for lowest and highest deciles; Gini index where provided.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Report decile shares, poverty percentage, and Gini coefficient with years noted.

rubrics_metrics.name: Inflation (consumer prices)
rubrics_metrics.description: Consumer price inflation rate percentage with estimate year.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide numeric inflation rate and year.

rubrics_metrics.name: Labor force and employment structure
rubrics_metrics.description: Total labor force headcount and breakdown by occupation (agriculture, industry, services) with years and notes on skill shortages or unemployment.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include unemployment rate and any qualitative notes (e.g., 'severe lack of skilled labor').

rubrics_metrics.name: Budget and public debt
rubrics_metrics.description: Revenue and expenditure totals (often in USD) and public debt as percent of GDP when provided.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Report fiscal year, revenue/expenditure figures, and percent debt with years noted.

rubrics_metrics.name: Agriculture products and major industries
rubrics_metrics.description: Key agricultural outputs and principal industrial sectors or notable manufacturing activities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: List primary crops, livestock products, and leading industries by name.

rubrics_metrics.name: Industrial production growth rate
rubrics_metrics.description: Annual industrial production growth percentage with estimate year.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide the numeric growth figure and year.

rubrics_metrics.name: Electricity statistics
rubrics_metrics.description: Electricity production, consumption, exports, and imports in kWh with years of estimate.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Report numeric values and year; indicate units (billion kWh or million kWh) as given.

rubrics_metrics.name: Oil and natural gas statistics
rubrics_metrics.description: Oil production, consumption, exports, imports, and proved reserves (bbl/day or barrels) and natural gas production/consumption/exports/imports/reserves (cu m) with estimate dates.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include values and dates; note if production is zero or NA.

rubrics_metrics.name: Current account balance and reserves
rubrics_metrics.description: Current account balance (USD) and reserves of foreign exchange & gold with estimate years.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide numeric values and years for context.

rubrics_metrics.name: Trade — exports and imports (commodities and partners)
rubrics_metrics.description: Values for exports/imports (f.o.b.), lists of main export/import commodities, and principal trading partners with percentage shares and years.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Report trade values, commodity lists, partner shares, and the year of the data.

rubrics_metrics.name: Currency, code, and exchange rates
rubrics_metrics.description: Official currency name, ISO code, and historical exchange rates (unit per US dollar) with years.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include notes on currency adoption (e.g., euro adoption) and multiple-year exchange rate series when listed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Fiscal year
rubrics_metrics.description: Official fiscal year definition or calendar used for government accounts.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: State the start and end dates or indicate 'calendar year' where applicable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Economic aid and donor/recipient status
rubrics_metrics.description: Amounts and sources of economic aid received or provided (ODA, IMF programs) with years.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: List donors/recipients and amounts with fiscal or calendar year references.

rubrics_metrics.name: Communications infrastructure metrics
rubrics_metrics.description: Counts and assessments for telephones (main lines and mobile cellular), telephone system quality (general assessment, domestic, international), radio and television broadcast stations, numbers of radios/televisions, internet country code, internet hosts, ISPs, and internet users with years.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide numeric counts, qualitative system assessments, and year of estimate for each metric.

rubrics_metrics.name: Transportation infrastructure metrics
rubrics_metrics.description: Railway length and gauge, highway totals (paved/unpaved), waterways, pipelines, ports and harbors, merchant marine composition, and airports (counts and runway-length categories) with years.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Report numeric lengths, counts, and runway classifications; include navigability or electrification notes where present.

rubrics_metrics.name: Military structure and manpower
rubrics_metrics.description: Military branches, recruitment age/obligation, manpower availability and fit-for-service counts, annual entrants reaching military age, and military expenditures in USD and percent of GDP.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Give numeric manpower estimates, age thresholds, and expenditure figures with fiscal years.

rubrics_metrics.name: Transnational issues — disputes, refugees/IDPs, illicit drugs
rubrics_metrics.description: Statements of international disputes, refugee and internally displaced persons counts, and illicit drug production/transit status.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide counts/estimates for refugees/IDPs, describe border disputes and narcotics roles (producer, transit point) with contextual notes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Page last updated / data vintage note
rubrics_metrics.description: Date indicating when the page was last updated (e.g., 'This page was last updated on 10 February, 2005').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include last-updated date to inform the vintage and relevance of the statistics presented.
